original_draft: Order Series Created Date (distinct order series)
why: Order series include renewals and therapy changes for existing patients

original_draft: Approved / decided, using decisions dated in the quarter
revised_definition: Approved / (approved + denied) for requests SUBMITTED in the quarter; pending shown separately; as-of date stated
impact: Q3 decisions included 46 requests submitted in earlier quarters
why: A cohort must follow the requests it is measuring

revised_definition: COUNT(DISTINCT auth_key) - one final decision per request
impact: 8 duplicate final-decision rows in the full history, 5 of them in Q2-Q3 2026
why: Repeated decision entries must not count twice

revised_definition: Group aliases to the umbrella first, then count distinct
impact: T12M patient-payer pairs overstated by 19; three-brand plan family 115 -> 110
why: A patient who moves between brands of one payer is one patient

revised_definition: Insurance in effect on the event date
impact: 76 of 316 Q3 new patients would have been assigned to a different payer
why: Insurance changes; history must keep the payer that applied at the time

impact: 6 requests on Jun 30 were silently dropped; 1 request stamped exactly at midnight would be double-counted by inclusive end dates
why: Timestamps after midnight on the last day fall outside a date-only BETWEEN

revised_definition: Order-weighted mean, median and P90; negative lags excluded
impact: 3 impossible negative lag(s) excluded across Q2-Q3; small payers no longer move the network figure
why: Averages of averages give a 9-order payer the same weight as a 70-order payer

original_draft: Dropped by the inner join to payer
revised_definition: Kept visible as 'Unmapped alias' and 'No coverage on file'
impact: 6 coverage intervals use unmapped aliases; 4 treated visits had no coverage on file
why: What cannot be attributed should be visible and routed for review, not lost
